title: Guided LLM elementary and high-school math problem study
summary: Adult online participants solve elementary- and high-school-level mathematics problems with either a prompted or unprompted LLM chatbot. Ten experimental variants combine five guidance conditions with two chatbot configurations to compare performance, confidence, and trust.

sources.title: Guiding Students in Using LLMs in Supported Learning Environments: Effects on Interaction Dynamics, Learner Performance, Confidence, and Trust
sources.evidence_quote: crowdworkers (N=356) were asked to solve math problems at the elementary and high school level with the help of an LLM chatbot

assessment.summary: Solve standardized elementary- and high-school mathematics problems with an LLM chatbot under an assigned guidance and prompting condition.
student_actions: Review assigned LLM-use guidance, if any.
Solve mathematics problems with chatbot support.
Rate confidence and trust before and after the task.
